name: SazStock – Stock Alerts and Control with Telegram for WooCommerce
author: alexsazonov

sections.description:
SazStock connects your WooCommerce store inventory directly with your Telegram bot. Instead of passively receiving email notifications, SazStock delivers actionable inventory control loops right into your messenger.

Whenever any product drops to or below your configured low-stock threshold, or sells out completely, you receive an instant alert card with product details, SKU, price, and inline action buttons.

⚡ Key Features

  • Real-time Stock Observation: Automatically detects inventory state transitions when orders are placed, stock is edited, or quantities change.
  • Smart Noise Reduction & Zero Spam: Baseline initialization on activation prevents false alerts on existing inventory. Repeated sales of items already in low stock do not trigger duplicate notifications.
  • 1-Click Telegram Control Loop: Each alert includes an interactive [📦 Open Product] link and a [🔕 Snooze 24h] button to mute alerts for that specific item for 24 hours.
  • Out-of-Stock Priority: Full stockouts (0 stock) always trigger immediate critical alerts, even if a previous low-stock warning was muted.
  • High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS) Ready: 100% compatible with modern WooCommerce database tables and Checkout Blocks.
  • Zero External SaaS: Self-hosted and serverless architecture. Connects directly to the official Telegram Bot API without third-party subscriptions or monthly fees.

External Services

This plugin communicates with the Telegram Bot API (https://api.telegram.org) over HTTPS to deliver inventory stock notifications and process interactive inline button actions (such as the 24-hour Snooze feature).

  • Service Provider: Telegram Messenger Inc.
  • Service URL: https://api.telegram.org
  • What data is sent: Store name, product titles, stock quantities, SKUs, and administrative notification payloads when stock thresholds are reached or when a test alert is dispatched.
  • Terms of Service: https://telegram.org/tos
  • Privacy Policy: https://telegram.org/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the sazstock-stock-alerts-for-woocommerce folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the ZIP file via Plugins → Add New.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to WooCommerce → SazStock Settings.
  4. Enter your Telegram Bot Token (from @BotFather) and your personal/group Chat ID.
  5. Set your desired low-stock quantity threshold.
  6. Click Send Test Alert to verify the connection, then click Register Webhook to activate inline 1-click Snooze buttons.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin work with variable products?

Yes, SazStock tracks inventory changes across simple and variable products managing stock.

Will this plugin flood my Telegram when I first install it?

No. SazStock implements a baseline initialization mechanism: it records the current state of existing products without dispatching alerts. Alerts are only fired when a product actively transitions across the threshold.

Is WooCommerce HPOS supported?

Yes, SazStock is fully declared compatible with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS) and WooCommerce Cart & Checkout Blocks.
